blocks.zh: 傳統微生物方法、替代/快速微生物方法導論與全球法規觀點
blocks.en: Conventional Microbiological Methods, Introduction to Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods, and Global Regulatory Perspectives

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 理解 Conventional Microbiological Methods（傳統微生物學方法，CMM）的原理、應用範圍與根本限制，尤其是 time to result（結果產出時間，TTR）過長與 viable but nonculturable（活的但不可培養，VBNC）現象
blocks.en: Understand the principles, scope of application and fundamental limitations of Conventional Microbiological Methods (CMM), especially the long time to result (TTR) and the viable but nonculturable (VBNC) phenomenon

blocks.zh: 掌握 Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods（替代/快速微生物學方法，AMM/RMM）的技術定位——qualitative（定性）、quantitative（定量）、identification（鑑定）三大應用類型
blocks.en: Understand the technical positioning of Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods (AMM/RMM), with their three application types: qualitative, quantitative and identification

blocks.zh: 熟悉美國（FDA）、歐洲（EMA/Ph. Eur.）、日本（PMDA）三大法規體系對 AMM/RMM 驗證與導入的具體路徑與溝通機制
blocks.en: Become familiar with the specific pathways and communication mechanisms for AMM/RMM validation and implementation under the three major regulatory systems: the United States (FDA), Europe (EMA/Ph. Eur.) and Japan (PMDA)

blocks.zh: 了解世界其他地區（ROW）法規現況，以及跨國多地區法規策略（含 dual testing strategy 雙軌測試策略）的實務考量
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory situation in the rest of the world (ROW) and the practical considerations of multinational, multi-regional regulatory strategies (including the dual testing strategy)

blocks.zh: 3.0 Conventional Microbiology and the Move Toward Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods 傳統微生物學與邁向替代/快速微生物學方法之趨勢
blocks.en: 3.0 Conventional Microbiology and the Move Toward Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Conventional Microbiological Methods (傳統微生物學方法, CMM): 以培養基（culture media）培養微生物並用肉眼或顯微鏡（microscopy）觀察結果的傳統方法，是目前藥典（pharmacopeia）仍在採用的主流檢驗基礎。
blocks.en: Conventional Microbiological Methods (CMM): Traditional methods that culture microorganisms in culture media and read the results by eye or under a microscope. They remain the mainstream basis of the testing still used in pharmacopeias.

blocks.zh: AMM/RMM (替代/快速微生物學方法): 泛指利用「替代性讀值技術（alternative readout-technologies）」與「分子生物學工具（molecular biology tools）」偵測微生物的新一代方法，目的是革新傳統以生長為基礎的檢驗模式。
blocks.en: AMM/RMM (Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods): A new generation of methods that detect microorganisms using "alternative readout-technologies" and "molecular biology tools", intended to transform the traditional growth-based testing model.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Section 3.0 就像一部紀錄片的開場旁白——先讓觀眾（讀者）知道「傳統方法（CMM）仍然是產業的基本盤」，接著才鋪陳「為什麼世界正在往 AMM/RMM 移動」。這與整份 TR 33 的敘事邏輯一致：不是要全面淘汰傳統方法，而是說明何時、如何、以何種科學證據導入新技術。
blocks.en: Section 3.0 is like the opening narration of a documentary. It first lets the audience (the reader) know that "conventional methods (CMM) are still the industry's foundation", and only then lays out "why the world is moving toward AMM/RMM". This is consistent with the narrative logic of TR 33 as a whole: the aim is not to phase out conventional methods entirely, but to explain when, how and with what scientific evidence new technologies can be introduced.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本段刻意強調 CMM「仍是法規指引文件（如藥典）的必要組成」——這意味著即使貴公司導入 AMM/RMM，CMM 通常不會被完全取代，而是可能長期並存（例如作為 referee test，詳見 Section 3.3.5）。
blocks.en: This passage deliberately emphasizes that CMM "remain a necessary component of regulatory guidance documents (such as pharmacopeias)". This means that even if your company implements an AMM/RMM, the CMM will usually not be completely replaced, and the two may coexist over the long term (for example, with the CMM as a referee test; see Section 3.3.5).

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼即使 AMM/RMM 技術日益成熟，藥典仍持續保留傳統 CMM 條文？
blocks.en: Why do pharmacopeias continue to retain the conventional CMM texts even as AMM/RMM technologies become increasingly mature?

blocks.zh: 「alternative readout-technologies」與「molecular biology tools」分別可能對應哪些你熟悉的檢驗技術（如 ATP bioluminescence、PCR）？
blocks.en: Which testing technologies you are familiar with (such as ATP bioluminescence and PCR) might correspond to "alternative readout-technologies" and "molecular biology tools" respectively?

blocks.zh: 3.1 Conventional Microbiological Methods 傳統微生物學方法
blocks.en: 3.1 Conventional Microbiological Methods

blocks.zh: Time to Result (結果產出時間, TTR): 從取樣到取得可判讀結果所需的時間。CMM 需要數天（甚至到 14 天無菌測試），是導入 AMM/RMM 最核心的動機之一。
blocks.en: Time to Result (TTR): The time from sampling to obtaining a readable result. CMM take several days (up to 14 days for the sterility test), which is one of the core motivations for implementing an AMM/RMM.

blocks.zh: Viable But Nonculturable (活的但不可培養, VBNC): 微生物受到營養不足、抗菌劑、熱、去污氣體等環境壓力後，雖然仍存活卻無法在培養基上生長增殖，導致傳統平板培養法「偽陰性」的重要根源之一。
blocks.en: Viable But Nonculturable (VBNC): After environmental stresses such as nutrient deprivation, antimicrobial agents, heat or decontaminating gases, microorganisms remain alive but cannot grow and multiply on culture media. This is one of the important sources of "false negatives" in conventional plate culture.

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management (品質風險管理, QRM): ICH Q9(R1) 所定義的系統性風險評估、控制、溝通與審查流程，是評估是否導入 AMM/RMM 的決策框架基礎。
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management (QRM): The systematic process of risk assessment, control, communication and review defined in ICH Q9(R1), which forms the basis of the decision framework for evaluating whether to implement an AMM/RMM.

blocks.zh: VBNC 現象就像是「裝睡的人」：這些微生物並沒有死亡（活的），但因為壓力或環境不佳而進入類似冬眠的狀態，在傳統培養基上「叫不醒、長不出來」。如果只依賴傳統平板培養判定「無菌」，可能誤判成陰性結果——但其實病原體只是暫時沉默，並未真正消失。這正是 AMM/RMM（例如可偵測代謝活性或核酸訊號的技術）能提供額外保障的原因。
blocks.en: The VBNC phenomenon is like a "person pretending to sleep": these microorganisms are not dead (they are viable), but because of stress or a poor environment they enter a hibernation-like state, and on conventional media they "cannot be woken up and will not grow". If "sterile" is judged solely on conventional plate culture, it may be wrongly read as a negative result, when in fact the pathogen is only temporarily silent and has not really gone away. This is exactly why AMM/RMM (for example, technologies that can detect metabolic activity or nucleic acid signals) can provide additional assurance.

blocks.zh: 本節列舉的七項 AMM/RMM 導入效益（改善 TTR、預防污染、維持微生物管控狀態、加速調查、即時趨勢監測、改善數據誠信、優化取樣點）都必須放在 QRM 框架下評估，且引用了 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022)、FDA cGMP 21 世紀倡議、PAT 指引與 USP <1071> 作為法規依據——換言之，導入 AMM/RMM 不是單純的效率工程專案，而是一項需要跨品質系統整合的風險管理決策。
blocks.en: The seven benefits of implementing an AMM/RMM listed in this section (improved TTR, contamination prevention, maintaining the microbial state of control, faster investigations, real-time trend monitoring, improved data integrity, and optimized sampling locations) must all be evaluated within the QRM framework, and the section cites EU GMP Annex 1 (2022), the FDA cGMP for the 21st Century initiative, the PAT guidance and USP <1071> as the regulatory basis. In other words, implementing an AMM/RMM is not simply an efficiency-engineering project but a risk management decision that requires integration across the quality system.

blocks.zh: USP <1071> 特別針對「無菌短效期產品（sterile short-life products）」的風險導向快速放行，這與 ATMP、核醫產品、公衛緊急應變藥品高度相關，是 CDMO 服務個人化醫療客戶時必須熟悉的法規工具。
blocks.en: USP <1071> specifically addresses the risk-based rapid release of "sterile short-life products". This is highly relevant to ATMPs, nuclear medicine products and public health emergency drugs, and is a regulatory tool that a CDMO serving personalized medicine clients must be familiar with.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 若 Amaran 的 QC 實驗室在無菌測試中連續出現偶發性陽性結果，卻在調查中反覆培養不出致病菌，VBNC 現象可能是原因之一。此時可考慮導入具備代謝活性偵測（如 ATP 生物冷光）或核酸偵測（如 PCR）能力的 AMM/RMM 作為輔助確認工具，而非僅依賴傳統重複培養，以避免因偽陰性而誤判產品無菌狀態，危及病人安全。
blocks.en: If Amaran's QC laboratory repeatedly sees sporadic positive results in sterility testing but cannot repeatedly culture a causative organism during the investigation, the VBNC phenomenon may be one of the causes. In that case, consider implementing an AMM/RMM capable of metabolic activity detection (such as ATP bioluminescence) or nucleic acid detection (such as PCR) as a supplementary confirmation tool, rather than relying only on repeated conventional culture, to avoid misjudging the sterility status of the product because of a false negative and endangering patient safety.

blocks.zh: CMM 的哪些內在限制（生長速度、選擇性、培養基品質、樣品分布）最容易在你的實驗室造成誤判風險？
blocks.en: Which inherent limitations of CMM (growth rate, selectivity, media quality, sample distribution) are most likely to create a risk of misjudgment in your laboratory?

blocks.zh: VBNC 與 dormancy（休眠）狀態，對「無菌測試陰性結果」的可信度分別會造成什麼樣的挑戰？
blocks.en: What challenges do VBNC and dormancy states each pose to the credibility of a "negative sterility test result"?

blocks.zh: 七項 AMM/RMM 導入效益中，哪一項對你所服務的 ATMP／短效期產品客戶最具吸引力？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the seven benefits of implementing an AMM/RMM, which is the most attractive to your ATMP / short-shelf-life product clients, and why?

blocks.zh: 3.2 Introduction to Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods 替代/快速微生物學方法導論
blocks.en: 3.2 Introduction to Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods

blocks.zh: Qualitative (定性): 偵測特定微生物或微生物族群是否存在（有/無）。Quantitative (定量): 計算樣品中微生物的實際數量。Identification (鑑定): 將分離出的菌株鑑定到屬（genus）、種（species）、甚至株（strain）等級。這三大應用類型是後續 Section 3.8.1 分類所有 AMM/RMM 技術的基礎架構。
blocks.en: Qualitative: Detects whether specific microorganisms or groups of microorganisms are present (yes/no). Quantitative: Counts the actual number of microorganisms in the sample. Identification: Identifies isolated strains to the genus, species or even strain level. These three application types are the basic framework for the classification of all AMM/RMM technologies in the later Section 3.8.1.

blocks.zh: 定性、定量、鑑定三者的關係，就像機場安檢的三層次：第一層（定性）只問「行李裡有沒有違禁品？」；第二層（定量）進一步問「有幾件違禁品？」；第三層（鑑定）則是「這是什麼違禁品、屬於哪一類？」不同的 AMM/RMM 技術平台，就像不同等級的安檢儀器，各自擅長回答上述其中一層或多層的問題。
blocks.en: The relationship among qualitative, quantitative and identification is like the three layers of airport security. The first layer (qualitative) only asks "is there any prohibited item in the luggage?". The second layer (quantitative) goes further and asks "how many prohibited items are there?". The third layer (identification) asks "what exactly is the prohibited item, and what category does it belong to?". Different AMM/RMM technology platforms are like security scanners of different grades, each good at answering one or more of these layers.

blocks.zh: 本節特別強調 AMM/RMM 在「數據誠信（data integrity）」上的優勢——因為結果多為電子化擷取，減少人工判讀與抄錄誤差，這對於強調 21 CFR Part 11 電子記錄合規性的 CDMO 而言，是導入 AMM/RMM 時可向客戶與稽核單位強調的附加價值，而不只是速度上的提升。
blocks.en: This section specifically stresses the advantage of AMM/RMM for "data integrity": because results are mostly captured electronically, manual reading and transcription errors are reduced. For a CDMO that emphasizes 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record compliance, this is added value that can be highlighted to clients and auditors when implementing an AMM/RMM, beyond the gain in speed alone.

blocks.zh: 你目前的檢驗流程中，哪些步驟屬於「定性」判斷？哪些需要「定量」數據？哪些需要「鑑定」到種/株層級？
blocks.en: In your current testing workflow, which steps are "qualitative" judgments? Which require "quantitative" data? Which need identification to the species/strain level?

blocks.zh: 「數據誠信」的提升如何具體降低 Part 11 電子紀錄相關的稽核風險？
blocks.en: How exactly does improved "data integrity" reduce audit risk related to Part 11 electronic records?

blocks.zh: 3.3 Regulatory Perspectives 法規觀點
blocks.en: 3.3 Regulatory Perspectives

blocks.zh: Comparable / Superior / Noninferior (可比對／優於／非劣性): 法規機關接受新檢驗方法取代舊方法的三種等效性判定標準。「Noninferior（非劣性）」是最常見的最低門檻，代表新方法的表現不會比舊方法差；「Comparable」與「Superior」則進一步要求相當或更佳的表現。
blocks.en: Comparable / Superior / Noninferior: The three equivalence criteria under which regulators accept a new test method to replace an old one. "Noninferior" is the most common minimum threshold, meaning that the new method performs no worse than the old one; "Comparable" and "Superior" further require equal or better performance.

blocks.zh: Open Dialogue (早期溝通對話): TR 33 反覆強調，在規劃驗證方案之前，應主動與法規機關展開對話——這不是選項，而是降低導入失敗風險的關鍵作法。
blocks.en: Open Dialogue: TR 33 repeatedly stresses that you should proactively open a dialogue with the regulator before planning the validation protocol. This is not optional but a key practice for reducing the risk of implementation failure.

blocks.zh: 「是否需要正式法規送審」的判斷，就像蓋房子需不需要申請建照：更動客廳裝潢（如 EM、原物料、水質等不影響上市藥證核准範疇的測試）通常不需要建照，但仍要符合建築法規、隨時可能被稽查；但若要更動承重牆結構（如影響上市藥證中登記的最終產品放行方法），就必須先申請建照（正式法規送審）才能動工。
blocks.en: Deciding "whether a formal regulatory submission is needed" is like deciding whether you need a building permit to build a house. Changing the living-room decor (such as EM, raw materials, water testing and other tests that do not affect what is covered by the marketing authorization) usually needs no permit, but you must still comply with building codes and may be inspected at any time. If you want to change the load-bearing walls (such as the final product release method registered in the marketing authorization), you must first apply for a permit (a formal regulatory submission) before you can start work.

blocks.zh: 切記：即使某項 AMM/RMM 應用「不需要正式送審」（例如 in-process、原物料、水質、EM 樣品），法規機關仍會在稽核（site inspection）時檢視其驗證完整性——「不用送審」不等於「不用驗證」，這是常見的誤解，也是稽核缺失的高風險來源。
blocks.en: Remember: even if an AMM/RMM application "does not require a formal submission" (for example in-process, raw material, water and EM samples), the regulator will still examine the completeness of its validation during a site inspection. "No submission needed" does not mean "no validation needed". This is a common misunderstanding and a high-risk source of audit findings.

blocks.zh: 「Comparable」「Superior」「Noninferior」三種等效性宣稱，分別需要什麼樣等級的統計驗證強度？
blocks.en: What level of statistical validation strength is required for each of the three equivalence claims, "Comparable", "Superior" and "Noninferior"?

blocks.zh: 如果貴公司計畫將某 AMM/RMM 用於 EM 監測（不需正式送審），QA 部門仍須準備哪些文件以因應稽核？
blocks.en: If your company plans to use an AMM/RMM for EM monitoring (which needs no formal submission), what documents must QA still prepare to be ready for audits?

blocks.zh: 為何「及早與法規機關對話」能降低導入 AMM/RMM 失敗的風險？你認為理想的溝通時間點應該落在專案的哪個階段？
blocks.en: Why does "early dialogue with regulators" reduce the risk of AMM/RMM implementation failure? At what stage of the project do you think the ideal time for communication falls?

blocks.zh: 3.3.1 United States 美國
blocks.en: 3.3.1 United States

blocks.zh: Comparability Protocol (可比對性協議, CP): 一種預先提交給 FDA 審查的驗證方案（通常以 prior approval supplement 形式送審），內容包含驗證研究設計與可接受標準。一旦協議獲批，廠商即可依此協議執行驗證，大幅降低事後被要求重做的風險，特別適合「多產品/多製程共用同一 AMM/RMM」的情境。
blocks.en: Comparability Protocol (CP): A validation protocol submitted to the FDA for review in advance (usually as a prior approval supplement), containing the validation study design and acceptance criteria. Once the protocol is approved, the manufacturer can perform the validation according to it, greatly reducing the risk of being asked to redo work afterward. It is especially suitable where "multiple products/processes share the same AMM/RMM".

blocks.zh: INTERACT / Type-C / Emerging Technology Program: FDA 提供的三種不同階段溝通管道——INTERACT 適用於 pre-IND 早期構想討論；Type-C 適用於已有明確申請案（application）的驗證策略對齊；Emerging Technology Program 則不限於特定申請案，適合真正全新技術的產業對話。
blocks.en: INTERACT / Type-C / Emerging Technology Program: Three FDA communication channels for different stages. INTERACT is for early pre-IND discussion of ideas. Type-C is for aligning the validation strategy when a specific application already exists. The Emerging Technology Program is not tied to a specific application and suits industry dialogue on genuinely new technology.

blocks.zh: FDA 的多元溝通管道就像看病前的「分級掛號」：如果只是想先諮詢一個全新的技術構想（還沒有具體病歷/申請案），可以走 Emerging Technology Program，像是掛「衛教諮詢門診」；如果已經有明確病歷（IND 申請前），可以走 INTERACT，像是「初診門診」；如果病歷已經很完整、只是要調整既有療程（已核准產品的變更），則走 Type-C，像是「複診門診」。找對門診管道，才能得到最有效率的回覆。
blocks.en: The FDA's multiple communication channels are like "tiered registration" before seeing a doctor. If you only want to consult first about a brand-new technology idea (with no specific medical record/application yet), you can use the Emerging Technology Program, like booking a "health education consultation clinic". If you already have a clear record (before an IND application), you can use INTERACT, like an "initial visit clinic". If the record is already complete and you only want to adjust an existing course of treatment (a change to an approved product), you use Type-C, like a "follow-up clinic". Only by choosing the right channel can you get the most efficient reply.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：INTERACT 與 Type-C 會議的共同限制是「必須與某個申請案（application）相關」——如果貴公司只是想探索一項全新技術、尚無具體申請案，Emerging Technology Program 才是正確管道，這點常被誤用。
blocks.en: Note in particular: a shared restriction of INTERACT and Type-C meetings is that they "must relate to an application". If your company only wants to explore a brand-new technology and has no specific application yet, the Emerging Technology Program is the correct channel. This point is often misused.

blocks.zh: FDA 明確建議以 USP <1223>、Ph. Eur. 5.1.6、PDA TR 33 三者作為驗證與導入的主要參考資源——這三份文件應被視為「三位一體」的驗證架構，而非互斥選項。
blocks.en: The FDA explicitly recommends USP <1223>, Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 and PDA TR 33 as the main reference resources for validation and implementation. These three documents should be regarded as a "trinity" validation framework rather than mutually exclusive options.

blocks.zh: 假設 Amaran 計畫為多個客戶的無菌充填製程導入同一款商業化 AMM/RMM 快速無菌測試平台。由於此技術將重複套用於多個產品／製程，FDA Comparability Protocol (CP) 途徑會是效率最高的選擇：先提交一份涵蓋通用驗證研究設計與可接受標準的 CP，經 FDA 核准後，即可依此協議快速套用到各客戶產品，避免每個產品都要重新走一次完整送審流程。
blocks.en: Suppose Amaran plans to implement the same commercial AMM/RMM rapid sterility testing platform for the aseptic filling processes of several clients. Because this technology will be applied repeatedly to multiple products/processes, the FDA Comparability Protocol (CP) route would be the most efficient choice. A CP covering the general validation study design and acceptance criteria is submitted first, and once the FDA approves it, the protocol can be applied quickly to each client's product, avoiding a full submission process for every product.

blocks.zh: 如果貴公司正在評估一項全新（業界尚無先例）的 AMM/RMM 技術，應優先選擇哪一種 FDA 溝通管道？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your company is evaluating a brand-new AMM/RMM technology (with no precedent in the industry), which FDA communication channel should you choose first, and why?

blocks.zh: FDA Comparability Protocol 與一般逐案送審相比，在「多產品共用同一技術」情境下能節省哪些成本與時間？
blocks.en: Compared with ordinary case-by-case submissions, what costs and time does an FDA Comparability Protocol save when "multiple products share the same technology"?

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 610.12（2012 年修正）與 2020 年基因治療 CMC 指引，分別如何反映法規對「短效期/即用型產品」替代滅菌測試的彈性？
blocks.en: How do 21 CFR 610.12 (as amended in 2012) and the 2020 gene therapy CMC guidance each reflect regulatory flexibility in allowing alternatives to the sterility test for "short-shelf-life/ready-to-use products"?

blocks.zh: 3.3.2 Europe 歐洲
blocks.en: 3.3.2 Europe

blocks.zh: PACMP (售後變更管理協議): 歐盟版本的「FDA CP」，分兩步驟：先送 Type 2 Variation 取得驗證方案核准，再依核准協議執行驗證後，將結果以 Type 1A（可立即實施）或 Type 1B（30 天等待期）變更送審。
blocks.en: PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol): The EU version of the "FDA CP", in two steps. First a Type 2 Variation is submitted to obtain approval of the validation protocol; after the validation is performed according to the approved protocol, the results are submitted as a Type 1A (can be implemented immediately) or Type 1B (30-day waiting period) variation.

blocks.zh: Work Sharing Process / Common Assessment (工作分攤流程／共同評估): 2023/1182 法規與 ICH Q12 帶來的新機制，允許同一項變更（如單一 AMM/RMM 技術）套用於多個藥證或多個上市許可時，可合併同時評估，大幅降低重複審查的行政負擔。
blocks.en: Work Sharing Process / Common Assessment: A new mechanism brought by Regulation 2023/1182 and ICH Q12, which allows a single change (such as one AMM/RMM technology) applied to multiple marketing authorizations to be assessed together at the same time, greatly reducing the administrative burden of duplicate reviews.

blocks.zh: EMA ITF / Qualification Advice: ITF 提供免費、非正式的早期對話，協助釐清法規路徑；Qualification Advice 則可能產出「產業通用」層級的方法學正式資格認證，適合具廣泛適用性的 AMM/RMM。
blocks.en: EMA ITF / Qualification Advice: The ITF provides free, informal early dialogue to help clarify the regulatory pathway. Qualification Advice may produce a formal qualification of the methodology at the "industry-wide" level, which suits AMM/RMM with broad applicability.

blocks.zh: Type 1A / Type 1B / Type 2 Variation 的差異，就像交通違規罰單的三種等級：Type 1A 像是「當場繳清、立即結案」（可立即實施新方法）；Type 1B 像是「開罰單後 30 天內若無異議即生效」（30 天等待期審查）；Type 2 則像是「重大違規需開庭審理」（需要完整審查與核准後才能執行驗證）。三者處理時效差異很大，直接影響專案時程規劃。
blocks.en: The differences among Type 1A / Type 1B / Type 2 Variations are like the three grades of traffic ticket. Type 1A is like "pay on the spot and the case is closed" (the new method can be implemented immediately). Type 1B is like "the ticket takes effect if there is no objection within 30 days" (a 30-day waiting-period review). Type 2 is like "a serious violation that needs a court hearing" (a full review and approval are required before validation can be carried out). The processing times differ greatly and directly affect project timeline planning.

blocks.zh: PACMP 與 FDA CP 高度相似但非完全相同——PACMP 是「voluntary（自願性）」流程，且明確分成「先核准協議、再核准數據」兩階段，中間可插入 EMA Scientific Advice 對話。規劃跨大西洋雙報（美國+歐盟）產品的驗證時程時，務必個別確認兩地流程節點，避免用單一時程表套用兩套法規邏輯。
blocks.en: PACMP and the FDA CP are highly similar but not identical. The PACMP is a "voluntary" process and is clearly divided into two stages, "approve the protocol first, then approve the data", with an EMA Scientific Advice dialogue possible in between. When planning the validation timeline for a product filed on both sides of the Atlantic (US + EU), confirm the process milestones for each region separately, and avoid applying a single timeline to two sets of regulatory logic.

blocks.zh: 2022 版 EU GMP Annex 1 明確「建議（recommend）」使用快速微生物測試與監測系統以強化污染防護——這使得歐盟已從「被動接受」轉向「主動鼓勵」導入 AMM/RMM，是近年法規態度轉變的重要指標（PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.5 相關精神一致）。
blocks.en: The 2022 version of EU GMP Annex 1 explicitly "recommends" the use of rapid microbiological testing and monitoring systems to strengthen contamination control. This shows that the EU has moved from "passive acceptance" to "active encouragement" of AMM/RMM implementation, an important indicator of the change in regulatory attitude in recent years (consistent in spirit with PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.5).

blocks.zh: PACMP 流程中，Type 1A 與 Type 1B 變更分別適用於什麼樣的情境？對產品上市時程的影響有何不同？
blocks.en: In the PACMP process, in which situations do Type 1A and Type 1B changes each apply? How do they differ in their impact on the product launch timeline?

blocks.zh: 如果 Amaran 的同一款 AMM/RMM 平台將同時用於三個不同客戶、於不同藥證下申請，Work Sharing Process 能如何降低整體審查負擔？
blocks.en: If the same AMM/RMM platform at Amaran will be used for three different clients filing under different marketing authorizations, how could the Work Sharing Process reduce the overall review burden?

blocks.zh: 2022 版 EU GMP Annex 1 對快速微生物監測技術的「建議」立場，會如何影響貴公司未來的 CCS（Contamination Control Strategy）規劃？
blocks.en: How will the "recommending" stance of the 2022 EU GMP Annex 1 on rapid microbiological monitoring technologies affect your company's future CCS (Contamination Control Strategy) planning?

blocks.zh: 3.3.3 Japan 日本
blocks.en: 3.3.3 Japan

blocks.zh: PMDA (日本醫藥品醫療機器綜合機構): 日本負責藥品與醫療器材審查的法規機關，其態度與 FDA/EMA 一致——只要證明 AMM/RMM 結果「comparable to or better than（可比對或優於）」CMM，即可接受。
blocks.en: PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency): The Japanese regulator responsible for reviewing drugs and medical devices. Its attitude is consistent with that of the FDA/EMA: an AMM/RMM is acceptable as long as its results are shown to be "comparable to or better than" the CMM.

blocks.zh: Japanese Pharmacopoeia G4/GZ 章節: 日本藥典第 18 版將 AMM/RMM 相關資訊系統性地收錄於 General Information 的 G4（微生物）與 GZ（其他）分類中，涵蓋螢光染色計數、基因鑑定、快速微生物測試、重組蛋白內毒素替代測試、藥用水品質管控等五個具體章節。
blocks.en: Japanese Pharmacopoeia G4/GZ chapters: The 18th edition of the Japanese Pharmacopoeia systematically places AMM/RMM-related information in the G4 (microbiology) and GZ (others) categories of General Information, covering five specific chapters: fluorescent staining enumeration, genetic identification, rapid microbiological testing, alternative testing for endotoxin of recombinant proteins, and quality control of pharmaceutical water.

blocks.zh: 日本藥典把 AMM/RMM 相關指引依技術類型分別編號放進 G4/GZ 章節，就像圖書館把同一主題的書按照子類別（螢光技術、基因技術、內毒素技術、水質技術）分別上架編目——方便使用者依技術性質直接查找對應章節，而不必翻遍整本藥典。
blocks.en: The Japanese Pharmacopoeia numbers its AMM/RMM-related guidance by technology type and places it in the G4/GZ chapters, like a library shelving books on the same subject by sub-category (fluorescence technology, genetic technology, endotoxin technology, water quality technology). Users can go straight to the chapter matching the nature of the technology without paging through the whole pharmacopoeia.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：在日本，若 AMM/RMM 用於「product disposition（產品放行決策）」，必須在藥證申請（或部分變更申請）核准範圍內使用——這代表日本對「放行用途」的 AMM/RMM 採取較嚴格的事前核准立場，與美國部分情境下可於稽核時才驗證的彈性做法不同，規劃日本市場產品時應特別留意此差異。
blocks.en: Note in particular: in Japan, if an AMM/RMM is used for "product disposition (product release decisions)", it must be used within the scope approved in the marketing authorization application (or partial change application). This means Japan takes a stricter prior-approval stance on AMM/RMM used for release purposes, unlike the more flexible approach in some US situations where validation is only examined at inspection. Pay special attention to this difference when planning products for the Japanese market.

blocks.zh: PMDA 對「用於產品放行決策」的 AMM/RMM，與美國 FDA 對非正式送審測試（如 EM）的立場相比，哪裡更為嚴格？
blocks.en: Where is the PMDA's position on AMM/RMM "used for product release decisions" stricter than the US FDA's position on tests that need no formal submission (such as EM)?

blocks.zh: 如果貴公司產品同時銷往日本與美國，在規劃 AMM/RMM 送審策略時，應如何因應日本要求「核准範圍內使用」的限制？
blocks.en: If your company's products are sold in both Japan and the US, how should you handle Japan's "use within the approved scope" restriction when planning the AMM/RMM submission strategy?

blocks.zh: 3.3.4 Rest of World 世界其他地區
blocks.en: 3.3.4 Rest of World

blocks.zh: ROW (Rest of World, 世界其他地區): 泛指美國、歐洲、日本以外的法規轄區，本節聚焦澳洲、中國、印度三個具代表性的案例。
blocks.en: ROW (Rest of World): Refers generally to regulatory jurisdictions other than the United States, Europe and Japan. This section focuses on three representative cases: Australia, China and India.

blocks.zh: Pharmacopeial Discussion Group (PDG, 藥典協調小組): 由歐洲藥典局（EDQM）、美國藥典會（USP）、日本厚生勞動省藥典部三方於 1989 年成立的跨區域協調組織，2023 年印度藥典委員會正式加入，象徵藥典標準全球協調的持續擴展。
blocks.en: Pharmacopeial Discussion Group (PDG): A cross-regional harmonization organization established in 1989 by the European Directorate for the Quality of Medicines (EDQM), the United States Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) and the Pharmacopoeia Department of Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare. The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission formally joined in 2023, a sign of the continued expansion of global pharmacopeial harmonization.

blocks.zh: ROW 地區的法規態度可分為兩種：一種是「借用他人的地圖」（直接採用 Ph. Eur. 5.1.6、USP <1223> 等既有框架，如澳洲 TGA），另一種是「自己畫地圖但參考國際地標」（自訂本地藥典章節但原則與國際接軌，如中國藥典 9201 章、印度藥典新章節）。無論哪一種，TR 33 都可以作為與當地法規機關溝通時的「共通語言」。
blocks.en: Regulatory attitudes in ROW regions fall into two kinds. One is "borrowing someone else's map" (directly adopting existing frameworks such as Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 and USP <1223>, as Australia's TGA does). The other is "drawing your own map but referring to international landmarks" (writing local pharmacopeial chapters whose principles align with international ones, as in Chinese Pharmacopoeia chapter 9201 and the new Indian Pharmacopoeia chapter). Either way, TR 33 can serve as a "common language" when communicating with local regulators.

blocks.zh: 中國藥典 9201 章特別強調「平行測試（parallel testing）」評估可比對性，且明訂 CMM 用於「上市後監督測試（post-market surveillance testing）」——這意味著即使 AMM/RMM 通過驗證並用於最終產品放行，CMM 仍可能在上市後監督階段被保留使用，形成類似 Section 3.3.5 所述的雙軌並存情境。
blocks.en: Chinese Pharmacopoeia chapter 9201 specifically emphasizes "parallel testing" to evaluate comparability, and expressly specifies the CMM for "post-market surveillance testing". This means that even if an AMM/RMM has been validated and is used for final product release, the CMM may still be retained at the post-market surveillance stage, creating a coexistence of two tracks similar to the situation described in Section 3.3.5.

blocks.zh: 建議：若法規機關對提案的 AMM/RMM 技術較不熟悉（常見於部分 ROW 轄區），應主動邀請設備供應商（vendor）一同參與溝通，有助於加速法規機關理解技術原理與驗證邏輯。
blocks.en: Recommendation: if the regulator is less familiar with the proposed AMM/RMM technology (common in some ROW jurisdictions), proactively invite the equipment vendor to take part in the communication, which helps the regulator understand the technical principle and validation logic more quickly.

blocks.zh: 中國藥典 9201 章要求「平行測試」評估可比對性，這與 Section 3.3 提到的「comparable/superior/noninferior」判定邏輯有何呼應？
blocks.en: Chinese Pharmacopoeia chapter 9201 requires "parallel testing" to evaluate comparability. How does this echo the "comparable/superior/noninferior" criteria mentioned in Section 3.3?

blocks.zh: 若貴公司產品同時銷往澳洲與印度，能否共用同一套驗證資料包？哪些部分可能需要因地制宜調整？
blocks.en: If your company sells products in both Australia and India, can the same validation data package be shared? Which parts might need to be adapted locally?

blocks.zh: 邀請設備供應商參與法規對話，可能帶來哪些效益與潛在風險（如利益迴避、資料保密）？
blocks.en: What benefits and potential risks (such as conflict of interest and data confidentiality) might come from inviting the equipment vendor to take part in regulatory dialogue?

blocks.zh: 3.3.5 Multi-Regional Regulatory Strategies for Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods 跨地區法規策略
blocks.en: 3.3.5 Multi-Regional Regulatory Strategies for Alternative/Rapid Microbiological Methods

blocks.zh: Dual Testing Strategy (雙軌測試策略): 當某一國法規機關未核准 AMM/RMM，而其他國家已核准時，廠商可能需要對同一產品同時維持「CMM（供未核准國家使用）」與「AMM/RMM（供已核准國家使用）」兩套測試系統。
blocks.en: Dual Testing Strategy: When one country's regulator has not approved an AMM/RMM while other countries have, the manufacturer may need to maintain two test systems for the same product at the same time: the "CMM (for countries that have not approved)" and the "AMM/RMM (for countries that have approved)".

blocks.zh: Referee Test (仲裁測試/裁決性測試): USP General Notice 6.30 明訂，當 AMM/RMM 與 CMM 結果出現差異、或對是否符合藥典規格產生爭議時，以 CMM 的結果為最終裁決依據。
blocks.en: Referee Test: USP General Notice 6.30 specifies that when AMM/RMM and CMM results differ, or when there is a dispute over whether the product meets pharmacopeial specifications, the CMM result is the final basis for decision.

blocks.zh: Dual Testing Strategy 就像一家跨國企業必須同時準備兩種語言版本的合約——即使大部分市場已認可「英文版合約（AMM/RMM）」有效，仍有少數市場只承認「當地語言公證版本（CMM）」，企業必須同時維護兩份文件，確保條款一致、隨時可因應任一方查驗。而 Referee Test 的角色，則像是「當合約條文發生爭議時，以哪一個版本為準」的仲裁條款——USP 明訂以 CMM 版本為最終依歸。
blocks.en: A Dual Testing Strategy is like a multinational company having to prepare a contract in two language versions at the same time. Even if most markets accept the "English version (AMM/RMM)" as valid, a few markets recognize only the "locally notarized version (CMM)", so the company must maintain both documents, keep the terms consistent, and be ready for inspection by either side at any time. The role of the Referee Test is like the arbitration clause that says "which version prevails if the terms are disputed": USP specifies that the CMM version is the final authority.

blocks.zh: Dual testing strategy 絕非單純的「多做一次測試」——原文明確列舉其隱藏成本：平行數據趨勢分析（parallel data trending）、規格對齊（specification alignment）、資源耗用增加，以及最棘手的「產品放行決策」如何整合兩套結果。規劃多國上市產品的 AMM/RMM 導入策略時，務必將這些隱性營運負擔納入商業評估（呼應 Section 3.4 財務評估架構）。
blocks.en: A dual testing strategy is by no means simply "doing one more test". The original text explicitly lists its hidden costs: parallel data trending, specification alignment, increased resource consumption, and, most difficult of all, how to integrate the two sets of results into the "product release decision". When planning an AMM/RMM implementation strategy for a product marketed in several countries, be sure to include these hidden operating burdens in the business evaluation (echoing the financial evaluation framework in Section 3.4).

blocks.zh: Referee test 條款意味著：即使全球多數市場已核准 AMM/RMM，CMM 的「裁決地位」並未因此消失——這再次呼應決策優先序中「無菌保證」凌駕於「商業與彈性」之上的原則：發生爭議時，永遠以最傳統、最具法規公信力的方法為準。
blocks.en: The referee test clause means that even if most markets worldwide have approved an AMM/RMM, the CMM's "arbitration status" has not disappeared. This again echoes the principle in the decision priority that "sterility assurance" outranks "business and flexibility": when a dispute arises, the method that is the most conventional and has the greatest regulatory credibility always prevails.

blocks.zh: 假設 Amaran 為某客戶產品同時申請美國、歐盟、及某一未明確核准該 AMM/RMM 的 ROW 國家上市。若該 ROW 國家法規機關最終不接受 AMM/RMM 放行結果，公司必須為該市場維持 CMM 平行測試線。此決策不僅牽涉額外的人力與設備投資，更須在批次放行流程中明確界定：當 CMM 與 AMM/RMM 結果不一致時，以 CMM 為最終仲裁依據——這應在偏差調查 SOP 與放行決策樹中預先載明，避免臨場爭議。
blocks.en: Suppose Amaran files for marketing of a client's product in the US, the EU and a ROW country that has not clearly approved the AMM/RMM. If that ROW country's regulator ultimately does not accept AMM/RMM release results, the company must maintain a parallel CMM testing line for that market. This decision involves not only additional investment in manpower and equipment, but also a clear definition in the batch release process that, when CMM and AMM/RMM results disagree, the CMM is the final arbiter. This should be stated in advance in the deviation investigation SOP and the release decision tree to avoid disputes on the spot.

blocks.zh: Dual testing strategy 除了「多做一次測試」的直接成本外，還隱含哪些容易被低估的營運與合規負擔？
blocks.en: Besides the direct cost of "doing one more test", what easily underestimated operational and compliance burdens does a dual testing strategy carry?

blocks.zh: 當 CMM 與 AMM/RMM 結果不一致時，為何 USP 選擇以 CMM 作為 referee test，而非以更「先進」的 AMM/RMM 為準？
blocks.en: When CMM and AMM/RMM results disagree, why does USP choose the CMM as the referee test rather than the more "advanced" AMM/RMM?

blocks.zh: 如果貴公司正在規劃一項新產品的多國上市策略，你會如何在專案早期評估「單一國家不核准 AMM/RMM」的風險，並預先規劃備援方案？
blocks.en: If your company is planning a multinational marketing strategy for a new product, how would you assess early in the project the risk that "a single country does not approve the AMM/RMM", and plan a backup in advance?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CMM 雖仍是產業主流，但受限於 TTR 過長、VBNC 現象與環境壓力導致的生長抑制，促使產業從 QRM 角度尋求 AMM/RMM 導入的正當性
blocks.en: Although CMM remain the industry mainstream, they are limited by a long TTR, the VBNC phenomenon and growth inhibition caused by environmental stress, which has led the industry to seek justification for AMM/RMM implementation from a QRM perspective

blocks.zh: AMM/RMM 依技術特性可分為定性（qualitative）、定量（quantitative）、鑑定（identification）三大應用類型，並帶來數據誠信與自動化效益
blocks.en: By technical characteristics, AMM/RMM fall into three application types, qualitative, quantitative and identification, and bring benefits in data integrity and automation

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA、歐洲 EMA、日本 PMDA 三大法規體系皆已建立成熟的 AMM/RMM 驗證與早期溝通機制（如 FDA CP、EMA PACMP、日本藥證申請範圍限制），但具體流程與時效各有差異
blocks.en: The US FDA, European EMA and Japanese PMDA regulatory systems have all established mature AMM/RMM validation and early communication mechanisms (such as the FDA CP, the EMA PACMP and the Japanese limit on the scope of the marketing authorization), but the specific processes and timelines differ

blocks.zh: ROW 地區（澳洲、中國、印度等）多數參考 USP <1223>、Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 或 TR 33 的驗證原則，但各自可能有本地化的額外要求
blocks.en: ROW regions (Australia, China, India, etc.) mostly refer to the validation principles of USP <1223>, Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 or TR 33, but each may have additional local requirements

blocks.zh: 跨國上市產品若遇到單一國家不核准 AMM/RMM，須考慮 dual testing strategy 及其隱藏的營運與合規成本；USP 明訂 CMM 為爭議發生時的 referee test
blocks.en: For a product marketed in several countries, if a single country does not approve the AMM/RMM, a dual testing strategy and its hidden operational and compliance costs must be considered; USP specifies the CMM as the referee test when a dispute arises

blocks.zh: 無論法規機關態度如何開放，「無菌保證」始終優先於「商業與彈性」——CMM 作為仲裁測試的地位，正是此優先序在法規層面的具體體現
blocks.en: However open regulators may be, "sterility assurance" always takes priority over "business and flexibility". The standing of the CMM as the referee test is the concrete expression of this priority at the regulatory level
